business_problem: Mohegan Sun needed hotel operations staff to access occupancy, inventory and room-status information in real time so guest check-ins and housekeeping decisions would no longer depend on centralized analysts and physical status boards.
solution_summary: Mohegan Sun expanded the use of IBM Cognos Analytics beyond its revenue management team so frontline hotel operations could work from fresher data. After upgrading from an older Cognos Business Intelligence deployment to Cognos Analytics 11, the property made dashboards and datasets accessible to housekeeping and front-desk teams that previously depended on analysts to relay updates. Occupancy, inventory and room-status data are now surfaced through large shared displays, front-desk stations and tablets used by floor supervisors. Cached datasets refresh every few minutes, allowing room adjustments and availability changes to propagate quickly through operations. Rather than treating analytics as a back-office reporting function, Mohegan Sun embedded it directly into the service workflow, helping staff coordinate cleaning, guest requests and room assignments more effectively across a large, high-volume hotel environment.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Delivers refreshed operational dashboards and datasets to housekeeping, front-desk and hotel management teams.

data_flow: Hotel occupancy and room-inventory data flows into Cognos Analytics datasets, refreshes every few minutes and is displayed on property screens, front-desk systems and supervisor tablets to guide housekeeping and check-in operations.
business_outcome: Mohegan Sun improved room-readiness coordination, saved supervisor time and increased customer satisfaction by putting operational insight directly into the hands of frontline staff.
architecture_clues: Cognos datasets are cached and refreshed every 3–5 minutes
Analytics were extended from revenue management into frontline hotel teams
Operational data is shown on large screens and mobile tablets
evidence_quotes: After an upgrade to the IBM Cognos Analytics 11 platform, a whole new world of user-friendly tools became available.
Using Cognos Analytics datasets allows cached data to refresh every 3 – 5 minutes.
Enhances visibility into occupancy and inventory, saving floor supervisors ~1 hour per day.
